exposure: Accidental and occupational exposure to viral hepatitis
outcome: Implications during pregnancy for viral hepatitis
Risk of perinatal transmission of viral hepatitis
cohort: Pregnant or postpartum women and individuals who screen positive for viral hepatitis infection, regardless of whether the onset predated or occurred during the perinatal period.
finding: This guideline provides recommendations for screening, prepregnancy, antepartum, intrapartum, and postpartum management of patients with hepatitis B virus and hepatitis C virus infection, and for hepatitis A virus and hepatitis B virus vaccination in pregnancy.
